title: The First Tree Awake
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The trees were bare on every hill,
The wind was cold and gray;
But one small branch began to bloom
And opened up the day.

[Chorus]
Oh, look and see, what do you see?
A branch of almond white!
He keeps His promise, every one,
And holds it in His sight.

[Verse 2]
The Lord said, "Jeremiah, look,"
And Jeremiah turned;
He saw the almond waking first,
And this is what he learned:

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
"Thou hast well seen," the Father said,
"I'll hurry with My word;
The thing I promised, I will do,"
The kindest thing he heard.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
A twig sat in a window jar,
And Scout looked every day;
Then one green bud said, "Here I am!"
His promise found its way.

[Chorus]
mood: Waking music. A light, lilting waltz in three under the voice, starting with a few single glockenspiel notes like buds opening one at a time on a bare branch, then filling in gently verse by verse. It leans forward with curiosity, like a child checking a jar on the windowsill each morning, and lands on a small, bright, happy surprise.
